argv:
$raw=Get-Content -LiteralPath "$own\group-04.raw.txt"
$show=$false
foreach($line in $raw) { if($line -eq 'FILE=apps/web/src/screens.jsx') {$show=$true}; if($show -and $line -match '^(bootstrap|scripts|tests|tools|qualification|README|Makefile|go.mod|services|packages)\\') {break}; if($show){$line} }
$raw | Where-Object {$_ -match '^(bootstrap|scripts|tests|tools)\\' -and $_ -match '(web|desktop|ui|pack|preview|ci)'} | Select-Object -First 80
function ReadRange($p,$start,$end,$cap=450) { "FILE=$p"; $n=0; Get-Content -LiteralPath $p | ForEach-Object { $n++; if($n -ge $start -and $n -le $end) { '{0}: {1}' -f $n,($_.Substring(0,[Math]::Min($_.Length,$cap))) } } }
ReadRange 'apps/web/src/workbench.jsx' 450 567 650
rg -n -o 'goal\.[A-Za-z]+|session\.[A-Za-z]+|run\.[A-Za-z]+|workspace\.[A-Za-z]+|permission\.[A-Za-z]+|data-producer="[^"]+"|title="[^"]+"|<h[123]>[^<]+' apps/web/src/continuity.jsx apps/web/src/workbench.jsx apps/web/src/screens.jsx
rg -n 'grid-template|@media|:root|\.native|\.continuity|\.panel|font-family|background|\.app-grid|\.workbench' apps/web/src/style.css | Select-Object -First 65
